'''Hap Brehg''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] 
who lived in the last [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during which he served in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as a [[Treasurer]].

==Biography==
Hap Brehg was born with a common [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] last name. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Brehg became a member of the Federation's [[Trade Federation Occupation Council|Occupation Council]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He held the title of [[Treasurer]].

During the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Brehg and the other members of the Occupation Council took refuge in the throne room. However, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala]] and [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] managed to enter the throne room and capture Brehg, along with [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Gunray]] and the other Neimoidians present. He was taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to await trial for his crimes.

==Personality and traits==
Brehg was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] with mottled [[Color/Legends|grey]] skin. He wore an outfit composed of different shades of brown fabrics. The overall outfit resembled [[Viff Almay]]'s robe but with two stripes on each of the sleeves.

==Behind the scenes==
Hap Brehg was identified in the [[Star Wars Insider 147]] Rogues Gallery article "The Devious Neimoidians Revealed." According to the notes for the article, found on the Facebook Page "Star Wars Sourcebooks," his last name was derived from [[Brehg]], a Neimoidian character from the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
